dedupe_keys.name: the space integrated ground information intelligent network traffic data

description: The Space-Integrated Ground Information Intelligent Network traffic data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yufu Wang. In the simulation experiment, OPNET simulation software was used to simulate the Space-Integrated Ground Information Intelligent Network environment to obtain the data. A satellite network composed of six satellites was used to simulate the data flow formed by the ground communication traffic through this network. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
